sentences.en: And it's, like, almost adjusting your entire self-concept to this new standard of, like, how you should be treated.
sentences.zh: 这几乎是在调整你整个自我概念，去适应这个关于“你应该被如何对待”的新标准。

sentences.en: And it's, like, so almost, like, uncomfortable because it also means that you have to sit back and be, like, oh, my God, that whole time I was being treated really badly.
sentences.zh: 这几乎让人感到不舒服，因为它也意味着你必须回过头来想：天哪，那段时间我一直被如此糟糕地对待。

sentences.en: I actually probably didn't deserve that, but I tolerated it.
sentences.zh: 我其实可能根本不该受那份罪，但我却忍受了。

sentences.en: And it's, like, having to sit back with yourself and be, like, wow, that can be, like, a really uncomfortable moment.
sentences.zh: 你必须回过头来审视自己，那种感觉真的会是一个非常不舒服的时刻。

sentences.en: Which I think is, so, might not create the anxiety around it.
sentences.zh: 我想这可能就是为什么会产生那种焦虑感。

sentences.en: I think I've been quite lucky.
I don't think I've had any relationships where I've been treated badly.
sentences.zh: 我不觉得我经历过任何被糟糕对待的关系。

sentences.en: Do you think it's more of a gendered thing, or?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这更多是性别差异吗，还是？

sentences.en: But I also, I don't even think you have to have had it.
sentences.zh: 但我也不觉得非得有过那种经历才行。

sentences.en: I think if you have an anxiety, whether it's, like, been from a previous friendship or, you know, like, an argument with a parent or whatever, a sibling falling out or whatever,
sentences.zh: 我认为如果你有焦虑感，无论是源于之前的友谊，还是，你知道，和父母的争吵，或者兄弟姐妹闹翻之类的，

sentences.en: and you have that sort of expectation of people who I care about don't care about me or, and
sentences.zh: 你就会产生那种预期，觉得我在乎的人不在乎我，或者……

sentences.en: it can just be, like, I honestly think, like, I mean, I'm not a psychologist, Jo, and you have to.
sentences.zh: 这可能只是……老实说，我不是心理学家，乔，你得……

sentences.en: You know, like, people who are born with particular sort of propensities or, I don't
sentences.zh: 你知道，就像有些人天生就有某种倾向，或者，我不知道，

sentences.en: know, like, anxiety around their social relationships or whatever, like, actually accepting, okay,
sentences.zh: 比如对人际关系感到焦虑之类的，实际上接受“好吧，这是一个我在乎的人，他们其实人很好，他们身上并没有什么本质上‘有问题’的地方，也不需要我担心”这一点，

sentences.en: well, this is a person who I care about, and they're actually just nice, and there's nothing inherently, like, cooked about them or something that I have to worry about.
And just, like, accepting that could actually be a really big thing.
sentences.zh: 仅仅是接受这一点，可能就是一件大事。

sentences.en: And I think if you don't, then you're just going to be, like, creating a different relationship in your head to the one that actually exists.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为如果你不这样做，你最终只会把你脑海中想象的关系，强加在现实中真实存在的关系上。

sentences.en: Like, you can't change someone else's behavior, but you can change your, like, expectations.
sentences.zh: 就像你无法改变别人的行为，但你可以改变你的预期。

sentences.en: And it could mean improving your expectations and being like, well, actually, this is, like, this new level.
sentences.zh: 这可能意味着提升你的预期，心想：好吧，实际上，这是一个新的水平。

sentences.en: And there are nice guys out there as well.
sentences.zh: 而且世界上确实也有好男人。

sentences.en: But it's funny when you meet one and you're like, oh, like, like, this is what I deserve.
sentences.zh: 但当你遇到一个好人时，你会觉得“哦，这就是我应得的”，这很有趣。

sentences.en: And it's, like, really shocking because it's, and it also can leave you, like, I think a lot of times people have, like, we were saying this tendency to, like, self-sabotage.
sentences.zh: 这真的很让人震惊，而且它也可能让你……我觉得很多时候人们就像我们刚才说的，有一种自我破坏的倾向。

sentences.en: And be like, I actually don't deserve this.
sentences.zh: 心想：我其实不配拥有这些。

sentences.en: Like, this must be a mistake.
Because I don't think it's, like, even if it ends up that that person wasn't very nice two years down the track, I don't think you can go that whole two years waiting for that
sentences.zh: 因为我不觉得……即使两年后那个人变得没那么好了，我也不认为你可以花整整两年时间去等待那个时刻的到来。

sentences.en: Or, like, for something to switch.
I'm often in that state where I'm like, well, what's next?
sentences.zh: 我经常处于那种状态，心想：好吧，接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: Like, when's this going to chop?
And sometimes you, like, push them a little bit to be like, I'm sick of waiting.
sentences.zh: 有时你会推他们一把，心想：我受够了等待。

sentences.en: Like, just show me your bad side now so I can get over it and decide.
sentences.zh: 现在就把你坏的一面展示给我看吧，这样我就可以放下并做决定了。

sentences.en: And then we can move on.
sentences.zh: 然后我们就可以继续前行了。

sentences.en: But whoever that person was, obviously I know who it was.
sentences.zh: 但无论那个人是谁，我显然知道是谁。

sentences.en: But I'm glad that you're happy in your relationship.
sentences.zh: 但我很高兴你在你的关系中感到幸福。

sentences.en: And also, you're nice doesn't have to be everybody else's nice, I think is the thing.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得，你认为的“好”不一定非得是别人眼中的“好”。

sentences.en: And this is, like, a whole other thing.
But I think there's a tendency, especially in, like, a place like Canberra where everyone kind of knows each other.
sentences.zh: 但我认为有一种倾向，特别是在像堪培拉这种每个人都互相认识的地方。

sentences.en: And it's a very insular sort of community of 20-something-year-olds who are, like, all very connected.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常封闭的二十多岁年轻人的圈子，大家都联系紧密。

sentences.en: To be like, okay, well, this person was really, like, I really hated them and they were really awful to me and blah, blah, blah, blah, and it just didn't work out.
sentences.zh: 人们倾向于说：好吧，这个人真的很……我真的很讨厌他们，他们对我真的很糟糕，等等等等，结果就是没成。

sentences.en: But that person might, you might have been awful for each other.
sentences.zh: 但那个人可能……你们可能只是彼此不适合而已。

sentences.en: And that's, like, it doesn't necessarily mean it will be the same thing for another person.
sentences.zh: 而且这并不一定意味着对别人来说也是一样的情况。

sentences.en: And this whole sort of thing of, like, oh, they were really awful, so, like, you know, I can't be with them because they must not be nice.
sentences.zh: 还有那种“噢，他们真的很糟糕，所以我不能和他们在一起，因为他们肯定不是好人”的想法。

sentences.en: But it's, people have different standards and different, like, yeah, metrics.
sentences.zh: 但其实，每个人的标准和衡量尺度都不一样。

sentences.en: And maybe they like that new person a bit more and are, like, willing to change their behaviors.
sentences.zh: 也许他们更喜欢那个新欢，也愿意为了对方改变自己的行为。

sentences.en: But I remember, like, I don't know if you said this to me, or maybe we said it in, like,
sentences.zh: 但我记得，我不确定你是不是跟我说过，或者我们是在某次讨论中提到的，

sentences.en: a discussion, but it's, like, no one, I thought, maybe some, I think some people are, but in general, people aren't inherently toxic or bad.
sentences.zh: 但我当时觉得，也许有些人是这样，但总的来说，人并不是天生就有毒或很坏的。

sentences.en: They just have friction with each other.
sentences.zh: 他们只是彼此之间有摩擦而已。

sentences.en: And it's, like, you know, the wrong person for you might act like the perfectly right person for someone else.
sentences.zh: 而且，对你来说不对的人，在别人眼里可能恰恰就是那个对的人。

sentences.en: This is a nice one, actually.
My ex reached out and wants to have a closure chat, but I had fully moved on.
sentences.zh: 我的前任联系我，想进行一次“了结谈话”，但我已经完全走出来了。

sentences.en: Should I chat with her or just say I'm not interested?
sentences.zh: 我应该和她聊聊，还是直接说我不感兴趣？

sentences.en: You don't owe your ex shit.
sentences.zh: 你根本不需要给前任任何交代。
你没必要欠他们任何东西。

sentences.en: I'm sorry, like, that might be controversial.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，这听起来可能有点争议。

sentences.en: You don't owe them fucking anything.
sentences.zh: 你根本不需要给他们任何该死的交代。

sentences.en: I think that's, I completely agree.
I think it's, like, it depends on what you want to get out of the next phase, you know, of the dynamic between you two.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这取决于你想要从你们两人之间接下来的关系中得到什么。

sentences.en: I think it's a really, really good way to make sure things aren't awkward between you two.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是一个非常好、非常好的方法，可以确保你们两人之间不会尴尬。

sentences.en: And a good way to even have a friendship with them if you want that.
sentences.zh: 如果你愿意的话，这也是和他们建立友谊的好方法。

sentences.en: Like, I'm good friends with one of my exes from high school, and I'm very happy for that friendship.
sentences.zh: 比如，我和我高中时的一位前任现在是好朋友，我非常珍惜这段友谊。

sentences.en: And I'm glad that we did have that closure chat, which happened quite a while after, actually.
sentences.zh: 而且我很高兴我们确实进行了那次了结谈话，其实那是在分手很久之后才进行的。

sentences.en: Quite a while after, being the fact that you guys probably had already moved on.
sentences.zh: 很久之后，意味着你们可能都已经走出来了。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah, it was, like, a month, two months or something.
sentences.zh: 噢，是啊，大概是在一两个月后吧。

sentences.en: Um, so, yeah, no, it depends on what kind of relationship you want to have with them.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以，不，这取决于你想和他们保持什么样的关系。

sentences.en: But then, also, it's important, I think, if you, if the relationship was nasty and you don't want to take yourself back to that place, don't do it, because it could be really bad
sentences.zh: 但同时，我觉得很重要的一点是，如果那段关系很糟糕，而你不想让自己回到那种状态，那就别去，因为那可能会对你非常不利。

sentences.en: I also think you get into a habit of, like, having repeated closure chats.
sentences.zh: 我还觉得你会养成一种习惯，就是反复进行这种了结谈话。

sentences.en: Because you have one chat, and then it's like, oh, but I have all these unanswered questions.
sentences.zh: 因为你进行了一次谈话，然后就会想，噢，但我还有很多未解的问题。

sentences.en: You're probably never, this is, perhaps we're giving advice to the person who's asking for the closure chat, but it's kind of, like, you're never actually going to get an answer.
sentences.zh: 你可能永远，也许我们是在给那个要求了结谈话的人提建议，但其实，你永远不可能真正得到答案。

sentences.en: Like, you just have to move on.
Like, human behavior is entirely irrational.
sentences.zh: 人类的行为完全是不理性的。

sentences.en: There's, like, absolutely no explanation and coherent narrative that's going to explain why your relationship ended.
sentences.zh: 根本没有任何解释和连贯的叙述能说明你们的关系为什么会结束。

sentences.en: And there's a point where it can get really unhealthy as well, when you, like, want to ask questions that aren't there, and it can just be bad for you.
sentences.zh: 而且在某种程度上，这也会变得非常不健康，当你想要去追问那些根本不存在的答案时，这对你来说只会更糟。

sentences.en: I was, like, you know, when you're really hurt, it makes sense that you're, like, I need an answer, I need an answer, but they're never going to give you an answer.
sentences.zh: 我当时就是，你知道，当你真的很受伤时，你需要一个答案是很正常的，但我需要一个答案，可他们永远不会给你答案。

sentences.en: And it just can really delay.
sentences.zh: 而且这只会真的拖延（你的恢复）。

sentences.en: We'll never give you one that's satisfying.
sentences.zh: 他们永远不会给你一个满意的答案。

sentences.en: Never want, you know, you've already decided what you wanted to hear, and they're never going to say that.
sentences.zh: 永远不会，你知道，你已经决定了你想听什么，而他们永远不会那样说。

sentences.en: So, I would say don't, don't have the closure chat.
sentences.zh: 所以，我会说不要，不要进行那个了结谈话。

sentences.en: Just be like, I don't think it's the right time for us.
sentences.zh: 就说，我觉得现在对我们来说不是合适的时机。

sentences.en: Give her some chance to, like, actually heal.
sentences.zh: 给她一些机会，让她真正地疗愈。

sentences.en: And it's, yeah, it sounds like by the fact that this person is asking the question, they probably don't feel like they want to have the chat.
sentences.zh: 而且，是啊，听起来既然这个人会问这个问题，说明他们可能并不想进行这次谈话。

sentences.en: Well, the whole thing is as well, like, there's so many, there's many dimensions to this question.
sentences.zh: 嗯，整件事也是，这个问题有很多维度。

sentences.en: So, I think the first thing is, like, obviously, there's, like, inequity in the playing fields, right?
sentences.zh: 所以，我觉得第一点是，很明显，这在起跑线上就是不平等的，对吧？

sentences.en: Because you've got somebody who's, like, evidently not over or feel that they haven't closed that door, and then someone who feels that they have.
sentences.zh: 因为一方显然还没走出来，或者觉得还没关上那扇门，而另一方觉得已经走出来了。

sentences.en: And then that's where the issues stem from.
sentences.zh: 问题就是从这里产生的。

sentences.en: I think if you're both in the same place about the situation, I think if you're both coming from an equal place of, you know, I'm a little bit hurt, but I'd like to have
sentences.zh: 我觉得如果你们双方对现状的看法一致，如果你们都处于一种平等的状态，比如，我知道我有点受伤，但我愿意进行这次谈话，

sentences.en: this conversation because I'd like to build a friendship with you or because I'd like to, whatever, I think that's fine, right?
sentences.zh: 因为我想和你建立友谊，或者因为我想怎样怎样，我觉得那样是可以的，对吧？

sentences.en: But if it's, like, you know that you're going to walk into that conversation and be interrogated for answers that you can't give, well, then that's weird.
sentences.zh: 但如果你知道自己走进那场谈话会被质问那些你无法回答的问题，那这就很奇怪了。

sentences.en: But I think if you did want to do it, I think it would then be really important to set boundaries,
sentences.zh: 但如果你确实想做，我觉得设定界限就非常重要，

sentences.en: like, really clear expectations of this is what I want to get out of this, what do you want to get out of this?
sentences.zh: 比如，非常明确地表达预期：这是我想从中得到的，你想要得到什么？

sentences.en: So that way there's, like, an end to those expectations, which is really clinical and, like, gross.
sentences.zh: 这样一来，这些预期就会有一个终点，虽然这听起来很冷冰冰，甚至有点让人不舒服。

sentences.en: But I think it's, like, it's one of those things where it's sort of, like, okay, I'm going to have this conversation which is going to be difficult for me.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这属于那种情况，就是，好吧，我要进行这次谈话，这对我来说会很困难。

sentences.en: I, you know, like, my favourite one is, like, you know, you book somewhere to go afterwards.
sentences.zh: 我，你知道，我最喜欢的方法是，你安排好谈话之后要做的事。

sentences.en: So, like, if you're going to be having this difficult conversation, you, like, I've got to be somewhere
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你要进行这次艰难的谈话，你（可以）说，我三点半有事，所以我有一个小时的时间，

sentences.en: at 3.30, so I have an hour and that way things don't drag on or get unnecessarily weird, it's sort of, like, there's an end.
sentences.zh: 这样事情就不会拖延，也不会变得没必要地尴尬，就像是有一个终点。

sentences.en: And if you set out and start what you want to cover in that time, which is really weird,
sentences.zh: 如果你列出并开始谈论你想要涵盖的内容，虽然这很奇怪，

sentences.en: it's like an agenda for, like, a work meeting, but if you set out what you want to cover and you have to be somewhere, it can't drag on or get weird or, like, oh, we didn't finish,
sentences.zh: 就像工作会议的议程一样，但如果你列出了要点，而且你还要赶去别的地方，谈话就不会拖延或变得尴尬，或者说“噢，我们还没谈完”，

sentences.en: so we have to catch up again, it's, like, I have an hour.
sentences.zh: 所以我们还得再约，（有了时间限制）就是：我只有一个小时。

sentences.en: I think the other issue with, like, closure chats is that often it can mean that that person is actually looking for you to be their emotional support through the breakup.
sentences.zh: 我觉得了结谈话的另一个问题是，它往往意味着对方实际上是想让你在分手过程中充当他们的情感支柱。

sentences.en: Like, because if they're looking to you for the closure chat, yeah, it might just be that they really do need an answer if you've cheated on them or if something, if you've done it
sentences.zh: 因为如果他们找你进行了结谈话，是啊，可能他们确实需要一个答案，如果你曾经欺骗过他们，或者如果你做了什么，如果你是突然之间（分手），

sentences.en: out of the blue, perhaps you do probably owe them an explanation if you cared about this person.
sentences.zh: 如果你在乎过这个人，你可能确实欠他们一个解释。

sentences.en: But it's also, like, I need to have this closure chat, not because I need answers, but because I actually need you to provide me with some emotional support.
sentences.zh: 但这也可能是，我需要这次了结谈话，不是因为我需要答案，而是因为我实际上需要你为我提供一些情感支持。

sentences.en: Because it's, like, you've gone from dating this person and then being that you're everything
sentences.zh: 因为这就像，你从和这个人约会，然后你是他们的一切，

sentences.en: to going through something that is really hard that naturally you would actually lean on that person for.
sentences.zh: 到经历一件非常困难的事情，自然而然地你会想要依靠那个人。

sentences.en: And so, like, I definitely, I did this in my last relationship where I was, like, oh, my God,
sentences.zh: 所以，我绝对，我在上一段感情中就这么做过，当时我心想，天哪，

sentences.en: I'm so hurt, but the only person I want to talk about it with is you.
sentences.zh: 我太受伤了，但我唯一想倾诉的人就是你。

sentences.en: So, like, and I think he was probably on the same page.
sentences.zh: 所以，我觉得他可能也是这么想的。

sentences.en: So it's like, we'll just talk about it together.
sentences.zh: 所以就像是，我们一起聊聊吧。

sentences.en: And it's like, well, now, like, the closure chat has just, like, meant that we never really truly, like, moved on or stopped communicating.
sentences.zh: 结果就是，这次了结谈话意味着我们从未真正走出来，也从未停止过交流。

sentences.en: Because if someone, like, ran over you with a car or something and you ended up in hospital, right, very extreme example, but you wouldn't go to them and be like, can you
sentences.zh: 因为如果有人开车撞了你或者什么的，你进了医院，对吧，这是一个很极端的例子，但你不会去找他们说，你能

sentences.en: Like, you know, I just need you there.
sentences.zh: 就像，你知道，我只是需要你在那儿。

sentences.en: And it's like, if someone has actively really hurt you, why, like, why is it logical for you to be like...
sentences.zh: 如果有人真的深深伤害了你，为什么，为什么你会觉得去找他们是合乎逻辑的……

sentences.en: Why do you expect them to have the answer?
sentences.zh: 你为什么指望他们能给你答案？

sentences.en: They're the ones who hurt you.
But for the person who asked this question, I'd say probably don't do it.
sentences.zh: 但对于问这个问题的人，我会说大概不要去。

sentences.en: Or if you do, take Meg's advice.
sentences.zh: 或者如果你非要去，听听Meg的建议。
并且安排好之后要去的地方。
比如去水疗中心放松一下。

sentences.en: A good, yeah, mutual meeting place.
sentences.zh: 一个好的、双方都能接受的会面地点。

sentences.en: A spa day, did you say?
No, not with the person, like, afterwards.
sentences.zh: 不，不是和那个人一起，是谈话之后。

sentences.en: Yeah, you guys should get couples massages while you talk about it.
sentences.zh: 是啊，你们应该在谈话的时候一起做个情侣按摩。

sentences.en: Honestly, yeah, mutual meeting place is good.
sentences.zh: 说真的，双方都能接受的会面地点很好。

sentences.en: Because then it's weird if they cry.
sentences.zh: 因为如果他们哭了，那会很尴尬。

sentences.en: My God, you guys are brutal at this.
sentences.zh: 天哪，你们在这方面真是太狠了。

sentences.en: What if she needs some tears?
sentences.zh: 如果她需要流点眼泪怎么办？

sentences.en: Can I, can I ask, can I ask the next question?
sentences.zh: 我可以，我可以问，我可以问下一个问题吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, do it, do it, do it.
sentences.zh: 可以，可以，问吧，问吧，问吧。

sentences.en: Wait, from your brain or from the sheet?
